findings.reproducer: Static: HTTPServer is single-threaded, binds guest-interface address, Handler parses headers before Authorization and allows 60 seconds per connection. A routable unauthenticated peer can occupy the sole handler with partial headers, denying legitimate bridge requests, repeatedly during the session.
findings.fix: Before launch prove network source restriction to only the ARTEX guest (and DVWA cannot route to listener); preferably dedicated peer-restricted socket/firewall plus bounded unauthenticated header budget and concurrent/isolated handling. Do not rely on bearer authentication to prevent pre-auth connection starvation.

findings.reproducer: Bind address alone does not enforce peer source identity. Offline source does not prove DVWA cannot reach 172.29.88.1:18761 or read the task key; no runtime network/FS topology was accessed under this review scope.
findings.fix: Parent must verify actual guest/DVWA network routes, namespace/firewall isolation and key file mount/permissions, and deny every source except intended ARTEX peer before live connection; no authentication bypass was found without key.

findings.reproducer: reviewer test_nonstandard_metadata_url_is_rejected: top-level metadata.url is denied despite being application data. Norma v0.4.3's actual oaReq does not emit metadata; tools and messages are deliberately exempt and passed.
findings.fix: If future ARTEX sends metadata, validate transport routing only at top-level explicit selectors, not recursively into application payload; retain strict top-level model/path/auth/host restrictions.
